# Cross-tabulate sex and arm
print("Cross-tabulation of sex and arm:")
sex_arm = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['arm'])
print(sex_arm)

# Cross-tabulate sex and severity
print("\nCross-tabulation of sex and severity:")
sex_severity = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['severity'])
print(sex_severity)

# Cross-tabulate arm and severity
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm and severity:")
arm_severity = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])
print(arm_severity)

# Compute response rates by sex and arm
response_by_sex_arm = df.groupby(['sex', 'arm'])['responded'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nResponse rate by sex and arm:")
print(response_by_sex_arm)

# Compute overall response rates by sex
response_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nOverall response rate by sex:")
print(response_by_sex)"}
